anomalies.description: A large, violent explosion erupts at an industrial facility, producing a massive fireball and rapidly expanding smoke plume; visible across frames f0–f6.
A second distinct explosive event occurs, with a new intense fireball emerging near the same facility, likely a secondary detonation or fuel tank rupture; visible in frames f9–f10.

A large explosion occurs at a multi-story building, producing a bright fireball and massive smoke plume; structural damage is immediately visible.; Secondary detonation or rapid fire propagation causes further violent ejection of debris and shattering of windows in adjacent structures, as seen by the sudden outward burst and flying glass fragments.

A violent blast event is evident: building windows are shattered (f0), debris and dust cloud expand rapidly (f1–f3), and nearby vehicles are violently displaced (f2–f4). The sequence shows a sudden, outward-directed energy release consistent with an explosion.

A white car is shown severely damaged—roof caved in and windshield shattered—immediately after the blast wave passes (f4–f5), indicating it was struck or crushed by debris or force from the explosion, constituting a secondary vehicle impact event.; A white car in the foreground shows severe roof and windshield deformation consistent with impact or blast-induced collapse; it appears stationary but heavily damaged after the blast wave passes.
